body: tools/decision/decision_card.py fills tools/decision/decision_card.md from one card JSON that points at the worksheet input. Fields: one-line thesis; variant view; what the price implies; stage-2 hard rules (pass/fail/unknown) and graded flags; stage-3 signals (PEAD avoid flag = SUE quintile 1-2 within ~63 trading days, L19; promise credibility shown sector-adjusted only with a peer median, L18; detector alerts); stage-4 soft flags and override log; P(>=3x/5y), P(<=0.5x), P(blow-up) beside a base-rate class from tools/decision/base_rates.json (null = n/a, never borrowed); EV of the 5-yr multiple vs the index hurdle; position size; dated kill criteria; pre-mortem; review date; gate log. Blocking gates (size 0): any hard rule failed (no override) or unknown (incomplete); PEAD avoid flag active; >=3 open soft flags without a written variant view; EV below hurdle; kill criteria missing/undated. Informational: outside-view check when model P is >2x or <0.5x the base rate. Sizing rule: min(0.25 x Kelly f*, tier cap at cost core 5% / satellite 4% / speculative 2%, liquidity cap adv_pct x ADV x days_to_exit / portfolio); f* maximises E[ln(1+f(M/H-1))] over scenario outcomes vs the hurdle multiple H. Emits three 5-yr paper calls (>=3x, <=0.5x, blow-up) and a decision record in memdb seed format with entry price, resolve_by and a mechanical resolution rule. Phase A: all sizes are paper sizes; practice cards say 'no verdict' and are tagged practice-example.

gates_blocking: >=3 open soft flags and no variant view
